Cupcakes

Susannah Blake

There's something irresistible about cupcakes, beginning with easy-to-make simple cupcakes. It then goes on to feature celebration cupcakes, Christmas cupcakes, firework cupcakes, indulgent cupcakes, and finally for dessert, fresh fruit cupcakes.
